selection_reason: First profile in each authored family, except destination P14 chosen prospectively because P13 contains no observed departure and cannot exercise a positive seek action.
common_observations: All six typed observable facts explicitly false throughout, except the per-profile replacements below. Latent fatigue/anxiety/home-pull come from the existing engine, not imposed answers.

schedules.P01: Synthetic named market placed at each road start. Its 500m observation disk is noisy AND crowded for minutes [0,30), then explicitly quiet AND uncrowded [30,360). Outside the disk observations are unknown, not false. Other registered goals retain sites.json locations.
schedules.P05: Continuous walking/time/distance states generated by the unmodified engine; no external pain observations.
schedules.P09: Lost awareness true throughout; family absent [0,90), present [90,360).
schedules.P14: Target recognized true throughout; synthetic park remains at the registered sites.json goal. Recognition is a supplied scenario, not inferred from proximity.
schedules.P21: Lost awareness true throughout; family's correction should yield walking, not waiting. Population fatigue rest remains allowed.
schedules.P25: Family absent throughout; clock advances from 08:00 to 14:00. Waiting should expire at 09:00.
schedules.P29: Lost awareness true throughout; family absent [0,90), present [90,360). After release, continuous walk/rest limits are generated by the engine.

checkpoint_checks: C site, walking seed 17 only: serialize at minute120, restore, compare minute121 against uninterrupted population. Up to32 paired checks, not additional independent populations.
facilities: Explicit synthetic Euclidean distance layer for market/park at registered goals; forest/water synthetic points 800m west/east of the start. Real OSMnx road graph unchanged. No claim these facilities or signals exist in KINTEX.
initial_person: Shared generic age78 dementia fixture, original notes and registered place labels retained; shared random-walk prior. This isolates conditional policy propagation and does not validate freshly generated onboarding priors.
failure_policy: Invalid model outputs consume their planned slots as not executable. Valid but semantically wrong outputs still run and retain interpretation-failure labels. No replacement response.
claims: Engineering propagation and mass/clock diagnostics only; not clinical behavior accuracy or missing-location accuracy. No new model, map, GPU, RAG or embedding calls.
